scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "django,nextjs" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "uv run python manage.py runserver" "cd web && npm run dev -- "
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently --kill-others --names "django,nextjs" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "uv run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000" "cd web && npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0"
scripts.dev:prod: cd web && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL='' npm run build && cd .. && uv run python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --clear && DEBUG=False uv run gunicorn core.wsgi --bind 127.0.0.1:8000
